feature: Northbound painted stop bar upstream of 10th St crosswalk
method: Manual interpretation from the georeferenced official ortho; parts are occluded by vehicles. No trajectory error was minimized.

uncertainty.digitization_note: Partly occluded paint; the source accuracy is not a measured stop-bar confidence interval. Use bounded geometry sensitivity and retain the approximation.

assumptions: Static photo alignment with the recorded road configuration must be reviewed; this is not a surveyed stop line.
